subject: EdgeWave evaluation: scope, hyperscaler comparison & test schedule
messages:
From: Alicia Romano <alicia@edgewave.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Great demo — quick follow up on tests

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo today — the team appreciated the walkthrough and the latency examples you showed. We had a couple of follow-ups from product and infra:

- Can Redwood run a side-by-side against our current hyperscaler provider (we're testing with one of the managed inference endpoints) using our 50-sample request set?
- We'd like a short list of success criteria (latency P50/P95, token-cost delta, top-1 semantic match) so the PM can sign off.
- Timeline: ideally we'd get preliminary numbers in ~1 week.

I'm copying Samir (infra) — he can share the sample set and any network constraints.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Romano
Head of Product, EdgeWave
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Romano <alicia@edgewave.ai>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@edgewave.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Great demo — quick follow up on tests

Alicia — thanks for the quick note and for hosting the session. Short recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap from our side:
- Primary objective: apples-to-apples comparison Redwood vs your current managed provider on the same model family (LlamaX-70B equivalent).
- Key metrics: P50/P95 latency (end-to-end), per-token cost, semantic quality (top-1 match against your labeled set), and memory/KV footprint for long sequences.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Samir shares the sample set + a short list of network constraints (if any) by EOD tomorrow.
2) We run three runs: baseline (your provider), Redwood default config, Redwood optimized (quantization + caching).
3) Deliverable: annotated CSV with per-request latency/cost, a short slide summary, and an evaluation notebook.

Timeline: we can produce preliminary numbers in 5 business days from sample receipt. If EdgeWave wants a stricter SLA we can prioritize compute on our Dedicated pool (let us know).

I've attached a draft test-plan (Redwood-test-plan-v1.pdf) that lays out the test matrix and owners. Internal owners are listed; happy to adjust.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Samir Desai <samir@edgewave.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Romano <alicia@edgewave.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Great demo — quick follow up on tests

Thanks Soojin — attaching the sample set (edgewave-sample-requests.csv). A couple constraints to flag:
- Some requests include long context (~8k tokens). We can't route traffic through public IPs; tests need to originate from our VPC or via a peered connection (we can provide a temporary SSH tunnel).
- Please don't store PII from these payloads beyond the test window; we have a 30-day retention requirement.

If you can confirm you can run the long-context workload and support the tunnel/network approach, we'll sign off on the sample delivery.

Samir
Infrastructure Lead, EdgeWave
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: EdgeWave test coordination (owners + schedule)

Team — forwarding the ask from EdgeWave. They want a hyperscaler side-by-side plus two Redwood runs (default, optimized). Key constraints: long-context (8k tokens), VPC/tunnel only, 30-day retention.

Proposed owners and actions:
- Marissa: test harness + eval notebook (runbook, metrics extraction). Deliverable: annotated CSV + charts. Target: run start Tue 24 Aug.
- Karthik: infra setup for tunnel + Dedicated priority (if we need reserved instances). Coordinate with Samir to confirm peering details.
- Vivek: define Redwood-optimized config (quantization profile, caching policy) and expected cost model; draft success criteria section for the slide.
- Soojin: customer comms, schedule, and final sign-off.

Success criteria (draft) — please refine:
- Latency: Redwood P50 within 15% of baseline, P95 within 20% (or better).
- Cost: token cost reduction >= 20% on optimized config vs baseline.
- Quality: top-1 semantic match >= 95% on labeled subset; no systematic truncation errors on 8k context tests.

Attachments: Redwood-test-plan-v1.pdf (test matrix + owners).

Please confirm owners and feasibility by EOD today so I can lock schedule with EdgeWave.

Thanks — Soojin
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Romano <alicia@edgewave.ai>, Samir Desai <samir@edgewave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Great demo — quick follow up on tests

Alicia / Samir — quick update and confirmed schedule. Thanks for the sample set and the constraints — validated. High-level plan below plus links.

Schedule:
- Mon 24 Aug: infra handshake (Karthik <> Samir) to configure SSH tunnel / peering. (Completed)
- Tue 25 Aug — Thu 26 Aug: run three test passes (baseline via EdgeWave export, Redwood default, Redwood optimized).
- Fri 27 Aug: deliver preliminary report + annotated CSV + short slide deck.

Deliverables: annotated CSV (per-request latency/cost/quality), evaluation notebook (link below), short executive slide deck with success criteria and recommendation.

Confirmed success criteria: (finalized)
- Latency: Redwood P50 <= baseline * 1.15; P95 <= baseline * 1.20.
- Cost: optimized config token cost <= baseline * 0.80.
- Quality: top-1 semantic match >= 95% on EdgeWave-labeled set; no truncation for 8k sequences.

Attachments provided: Redwood-test-plan-v1.pdf, SLA-draft.docx (for Dedicated priority pricing).

Links: evaluation notebook: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B1-edgewave-testplan/notebook
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/EDGE-137

Next steps for EdgeWave: please confirm you are comfortable with the success criteria above and we will run the tests this week. If you want a live walkthrough of the runs, we can schedule a 30-minute window for Thu afternoon.

Thanks — looking forward to results.

Best,
